title: Why the lonely in China are hiring 'temporary children'
summary: A new industry being dubbed the “loneliness economy” has emerged in China, with people hiring themselves out as companions to help the elderly.

blocks.text: In China's cities, despite the huge crowds, or maybe because of them, residents can feel very isolated.
Now, a new industry being dubbed the "loneliness economy" has emerged, with people hiring themselves out as companions to help the elderly.
The BBC's China correspondent Stephen McDonell visits a company that does just that, to see how their business works.
